```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rstatix)
})

# -----------------------------
# Load data
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"
)

meta_single <- read_csv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  )

top_sites <- c("liver", "brain", "bone")

df_site_top <- df_freq %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites)),
    end_motif = toupper(str_trim(end_motif))
  ) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

# -----------------------------
# ATGC-only filter (remove IUPAC/degenerate codes)
# -----------------------------
df_site_top_atgc <- df_site_top %>%
  filter(!grepl("[^ATGC]", end_motif))

message("Samples (top sites): ", n_distinct(df_site_top_atgc$id))
message("Unique motifs (ATGC-only): ", n_distinct(df_site_top_atgc$end_motif))
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------

# Shannon entropy per sample (ATGC-only)

# -----------------------------

entropy_df <- df_site_top_atgc %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    metastatic_sites = first(metastatic_sites),

    # entropy on valid probabilities
    entropy = {
      p <- freq.corrected
      p <- p[is.finite(p) & !is.na(p) & p > 0]
      -sum(p * log(p))
    },

    sum_p = sum(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_motifs = n_distinct(end_motif),
    n_rows = n(),   # should match n_motifs if one row per motif
    .groups = "drop"
  )

message("Samples: ", n_distinct(entropy_df$id))
print(summary(entropy_df$entropy))
print(summary(entropy_df$sum_p))
print(summary(entropy_df$n_motifs))
print(summary(entropy_df$n_rows))

```

```{r}
# -----------------------------

# Compare entropy across sites

# -----------------------------

res_entropy_kw <- kruskal_test(entropy ~ metastatic_sites, data = entropy_df)
print(res_entropy_kw)

# Effect size for entropy difference

res_entropy_eff <- kruskal_effsize(entropy ~ metastatic_sites, data = entropy_df)
print(res_entropy_eff)

# Optional: pairwise (shown for completeness; interpret cautiously if KW not significant)

res_entropy_pairwise <- entropy_df %>%
wilcox_test(entropy ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
arrange(p.adj)
print(res_entropy_pairwise)

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------

# Save outputs

# -----------------------------

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_motif_results_single_site_top3/ATGC_only"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

write_csv(entropy_df, file.path(outdir, "entropy_per_sample_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))
write_csv(as.data.frame(res_entropy_kw), file.path(outdir, "entropy_kw_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))
write_csv(as.data.frame(res_entropy_eff), file.path(outdir, "entropy_effsize_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))
write_csv(as.data.frame(res_entropy_pairwise), file.path(outdir, "entropy_pairwise_wilcox_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))

message("Saved entropy tables to: ", outdir)

```
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
})

# -------------------------------------------------

# Plot outputs

# -------------------------------------------------

figdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/figures_entropy/results_ATGC_only"
dir.create(figdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -------------------------------------------------

# Order sites by median RAW entropy (fixed order)

# -------------------------------------------------

site_order <- entropy_df %>%
group_by(metastatic_sites) %>%
summarise(med_entropy = median(entropy), .groups = "drop") %>%
arrange(med_entropy) %>%
pull(metastatic_sites)

entropy_df <- entropy_df %>%
mutate(metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = site_order))

# -------------------------------------------------

# RAW SHANNON ENTROPY PLOT

# -------------------------------------------------

p_entropy_raw <- ggplot(entropy_df, aes(x = metastatic_sites, y = entropy)) +
geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "grey85", color = "grey40") +
geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
labs(
x = "Metastatic site",
y = "Shannon entropy (ATGC 4-mer end motifs)",
title = "Global end-motif diversity (ATGC-only)"
) +
theme_classic(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
filename = file.path(figdir, "entropy_raw_violin_ATGC.png"),
plot = p_entropy_raw, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
)
ggsave(
filename = file.path(figdir, "entropy_raw_violin_ATGC.pdf"),
plot = p_entropy_raw, width = 6, height = 4.5
)

# -------------------------------------------------

# NORMALIZED SHANNON ENTROPY

# -------------------------------------------------

entropy_df <- entropy_df %>%
mutate(entropy_norm = entropy / log(n_motifs))  # log base matches entropy calc (natural log)

p_entropy_norm <- ggplot(entropy_df, aes(x = metastatic_sites, y = entropy_norm)) +
geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "grey85", color = "grey40") +
geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
labs(
x = "Metastatic site",
y = "Normalized Shannon entropy",
title = "Normalized end-motif diversity (ATGC-only)"
) +
theme_classic(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
filename = file.path(figdir, "entropy_normalized_violin_ATGC.png"),
plot = p_entropy_norm, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
)
ggsave(
filename = file.path(figdir, "entropy_normalized_violin_ATGC.pdf"),
plot = p_entropy_norm, width = 6, height = 4.5
)

message("Saved entropy figures to: ", figdir)

```
